deleteAccount.warningBody: Your account and all your personal data will be permanently deleted: profile, password, personal notes and stage cues on songs and setlists, availability and absences, your song votes, and your personal equipment. You will also be removed from every band you're a member of.

bandSettings.title: Management
bandSettings.hint: Turn features for this band on or off. Disabled features disappear from navigation; existing data is preserved and becomes available again immediately once you turn the feature back on.
bandSettings.financeAdminsHint: Only these people see the band's full financial overview and may create entries. This also grants them admin-equivalent rights for songs, equipment, files, and events – but no access to member management or this management page.

equipment.label: Equipment
equipment.description: Equipment catalog for the band and individual members (instruments, gear, accessories).

packlists.label: Packing lists
packlists.description: Checklists for rehearsals and gigs, built from the equipment catalog.
packlists.descriptionDisabled: Requires equipment (see above) – stays disabled while equipment is off.

finance.label: Finance
finance.descriptionOn: Income, expenses, and fees for the band. Visible only to finance admins; everyone else sees only their own entries.
finance.descriptionOff: Income, expenses, and fees for the band. Enabling this makes you a finance admin automatically if the band doesn't have one yet.

communication.label: Communication
communication.description: Email notifications for events, song proposals, files, and fees, plus sharing via WhatsApp. Each person decides in their own profile what they're notified about.

mediaPlayer.label: Media player
mediaPlayer.description: Play stored audio files directly in the app, including practice mode with tempo, transposition, and section looping. Linked YouTube and Spotify sources are embedded.

keyDetection.label: Key detection
keyDetection.description: Estimates the audio file's key at the press of a button in practice mode (an approximation, not always reliable – major/minor relative keys are hard to distinguish algorithmically). Never changes song data automatically; the result must be actively applied.

locations.label: Locations
locations.description: Catalog of gig venues with address, map, contact and technical info, and files – can be linked to events.

noBalance.label: No band account
noBalance.description: The band's balance is always settled. Income is fully distributed among members, expenses are fully covered proportionally by members.

bandBalance.label: Band account (band capital)
bandBalance.description: The band can hold its own balance. Income and expenses don't need to be 100% distributed among members – the remainder is automatically settled against the band account.

settingsForm.guestAccessHint: Automatically pre-fills the expiration date for new guest invitations – still freely editable there. Leave empty for unlimited access by default (as before).
settingsForm.publicFileLinksDescription: Allows sharing files via a login-free link. When disabled, existing links also stop working until you turn this back on.

actions.onlyAdminsManageFeatures: Only admins can manage features for the band
